SDN.note: A valuation database is not a declaration-processing system; no customs clearance system is stated.
No online government service for the public is stated.

facts.fact: Sudan Customs' information technology directorate says its own software officers programmed the electronic customs valuation database and the e-violations system, which were run on Oracle APEX and 19c.
The acting director general of Sudan Customs launched the electronic customs valuation database at the North Port, built by customs IT officers rather than a contractor.
